bio.text: Mike Flood was sworn into the U.S. House on July 12, 2022, after winning a special election in June 2022 for Nebraska's 1st District.
He founded Flood Communications, a Nebraska media company, in 1999, after studying at Notre Dame and earning a law degree at the University of Nebraska.
He was elected to the Nebraska Legislature in 2005 and in 2007 became its Speaker, the youngest in the state's history.
He lives in Norfolk, Nebraska, with his wife Mandi and their two sons.
